remarks: Best and Final, May 11th, by 5:30PM. Located in one of North Stamford's most sought after neighborhoods, this beautifully updated and move-in ready home offers over an acre of lush, level property and a fresh, light filled interior that's ready to enjoy from day one. The open-concept layout showcases vaulted ceilings, skylights and expansive windows that create a bright, airy flow throughout. At the heart of it all is a stunning gourmet kitchen with high-end finishes, opening to a dining room with sliding glass doors that lead to a spacious deck - perfect for entertaining and enjoying the outdoors. Just beyond, a warm and welcoming family room opens to a stone patio, offering a peaceful spot to gather or unwind. Three spacious bedrooms, include a serene primary suite with a beautifully designed, spa-like bathroom. The finished lower level adds versatility, featuring a full bath and walk-out access to the expansive backyard, ideal for a playroom, recreation room, and or home office. Don't miss the opportunity to make 238 Thornridge Drive your home. Schedule your private showing today!
